About us

Prowater Technologies, Inc. is a premier environmental engineering firm in the Philippines, specializing in water and wastewater treatment. We pair world-class technical knowledge with advanced treatment technologies to solve complex environmental challenges.

We have completed 100+ projects for commercial, industrial, institutional and government clients, from 53 Smart and PLDT sites to a solar-powered water treatment system on Pag-asa Island and 17 DENR sites nationwide.
